name: SH-3: non-usable section carries an observed indicator → gated, overhang, not clean

suppressed.detail: Required section 'prophet' ran but its premise failed (invalidated).

expected.explanation: Inconclusive: a possible threat signal (DNS spoofing / poisoning) was observed but could not be verified because required evidence was missing or invalidated. Not treated as clean.

why: W20/M02 (B162, MatrixDeterminativeEngine.swift:782-785): the indicator fired in a section whose premise failed (invalidated). The observation must score nothing — no coverage, fit, contradiction, or tier-gate contribution (rawStrength 0) — yet still be admitted to the honesty overhang (rawSupport 1.2, above the 0.30 floor). dnsSpoofing is hard-gated on its invalidated required section, and the run stays inconclusive ('seen but could not be verified'), never clean.
